You will work across a broad pipeline of acquisition and investment opportunities, with responsibilities including:
  • Financial modelling, valuation and investment analysis

  • Scenario analysis, sensitivities and assessment of investment returns

We are open-minded on where the right person comes from. You may currently be working within property investment, acquisitions, capital transactions, funds management, corporate finance, M&A, valuations or a related investment environment.

You will ideally bring:
  • Strong financial modelling and analytical capability

  • An understanding of valuation, due diligence and investment returns
  • Strong commercial judgement and an ability to look beyond the numbers

Technical capability is important, but equally important will be your attitude and strength of character. The environment will suit someone who enjoys taking ownership, wants to keep learning and is excited by the opportunity to work within a fast-growing investment platform.

Why consider it?
This is an opportunity to move into a highly active principal-side investment environment with a genuine pipeline of transactions.

You’ll work directly with an experienced Head of Investments & Corporate Finance, gain exposure to senior decision-makers and build experience across property, operating businesses, acquisitions and development.

The business is well-capitalised, continuing to grow, and offers genuine scope to develop as an investment professional as the platform expands.
